question: Are ANALYZE and FTS5 optimize worth running on production?
method: copy of /var/lib/nox-mem/epochs/current.db (1.61 GB) on ext4, exact FTS5 query of src/search.ts:410, 12 PT-BR queries x 15 reps, warm-up discarded, median; production untouched, nothing written to the live DB

analyze.verdict: do not run: measures negative (inside the noise) and installs sqlite_stat1, which changes the planner for every query in the system

optimize.verdict: not worth it as latency work; marginally worth it as disk hygiene (-58.7 MB, 3.7% of the file) - the user's call, needs an atomic snapshot

denominator.source: search_telemetry, n=394 since 2026-10-14, read-only, no probe
denominator.knn_source: bench-vec0-2026-10-21.json, measured on a copy of the same epoch

not_measured.non_semantic_leg: has_semantic=0 has only n=2 (median 691.5 ms) against n=392 with semantic (1349.0 ms); no query_hash appears in both arms, so the ~658 ms delta is indicative, NOT measured. Notable anyway: even without the semantic leg a search costs ~690 ms, of which FTS5 is 0.1% - where that time goes is unknown and was not pursued.
not_measured.why_not_pursued: 348 of 394 searches since 14/10 are probe:semantic-canary and none is a real agent; optimising search latency today optimises the probe
